systems.owner: Direction générale de la Sûreté nationale (المديرية العامة للأمن الوطني)
systems.tiers: citizens online; inaugurated at DGSN headquarters in Nouakchott on 18 December 2025; no count of stations or wilayas

note: The platform lets citizens request DGSN documents such as the criminal record certificate and file complaints and reports online without going to a security centre: a public portal, not the station's own record; nothing is said of how stations record.
